reviews.comment: Her note slides were straightforward to understand if you went to class. If you didn't, they were somewhat easy to self-teach if you were willing to put in the extra effort. Her tests are similar to the homework and practice exams. Overall, a great class.

ECON323 is not very difficult - homework is simple and is 30% of the entire grade, and both tests and the final exam follow the test/final review pretty closely. Additionally, prof hands out bonus quizzes that give up to 5% extra credit to your overall grade. Main complaint is that lectures are unfathomably boring, and I stopped going around March
She was hard to understand. Class is graded on 6 homework assignments and 3 exams, plus bonus quizzes for extra credit. Exams are similar to practice exams.

I probably went to lecture three times and exam days. Her slides are super detailed which makes the homework a breeze. Practice exams are identical to real exams so it prepares you well. Generous extra credit quizzes that can be done from home. Take her!!

She was a pretty good professor. I stopped going to class after the first test. Test are short and not too hard if you do some studying on your own time. She can be alittle hard to understand at time but other than that she's great! Lots of extra credit as well. Its a tough class but study and you will be good.

Her class was made up of 3 tests and HW. The tests were extremely similar to the review and HW questions. I would say the hardest part was the homework. She also gives many extra credit points, up to 5 towards your final grade just by completing in-class quizzes on Canvas. Essentially you could get an 85, and still get an A. Extremely easy class

Effort results in easy A. No surprises on any exams or finals. Actual test is formatted very similar to practice test and homework. Sometimes even same wording, but switched numbers. PowerPoints are also very detailed. Go to class for extra points up to 6 on 100 pt scale. Overall organized professor with very clear expectations for students.

Good prof, a little hard to understand and lectures can be boring but she's really nice and her slides make it easy to understand the material. I stopped going to class after the second exam and was totally fine. The most difficult thing was probably the homework but even then that wasn't bad at all. Would def recommend her

Not a bad class, but you will have to pay a little attention and put some work in for an A. Did not have a problems in lecture besides trying to focus for a long lecture. Homework assignments were not too bad and the TA's were great with prepping for the Exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Absolutely incredible. She truly is one of the best ECON profs here, take her if possible. Tests are super short and easy, gives a practice exam too that's nearly identical. Handful of homework assignments, very easy and you can check answers on Quizlet. Easy to understand and very polite, take Guo!

Very good professor. Just go over her powerpoint slides and you'll be fine. I''ve studied for the exams 3 days in advance and got above 95% in all of them. 2 unit exams and a final. Hw due on Friday's. In my opinion the hw was the most difficult thing but if you know the content or find a good quizlet, you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Overall the class was super easy if you attended lectures and studied for exams. If you do the homework and the review they set you up well for the Exam. Her lecture slides are really detailed and well written for someone even if they didn't attend the lecture.  She is super sweet. Best econ class I have taken so far.
Would totally suggest her!! Amazing powerpoint slides...had no trouble learning the material in and outside of lecture.
Makes material very easy to understand and exams/hw are all multiple choice test bank answers, no surprise questions on tests either! Super nice and clear, would totally take her again

She is just awesome. Incredible lecturer and educator. She will make you feel inspired and encouraged. Understand her homeworks to be successful on the exam, she is not out to get anyone. Just take her for 323!! Always accessible outside of class!!

She is always available for questions and is dedicated to students' success. She goes above and beyond to provide support. Her dedication to students' success is evident in their willingness to provide extra help during office hours. This professor is simplifying complex concepts, making the material much more accessible.

I didn't go back to class after the first two weeks. I taught myself the entire class. DO THE BONUS QUIZZES, just check everyday cause you won't know until the day of. Three exams, the last one is cumulative. The class is similar to past economics classes, just more detailed than the previous ones. If this is your first econ class, good luck.

Guo was an extremely average professor for me. Her lectures were a bit boring and seemed like they took forever. Some people say it's hard to understand her, but it really isn't that bad if you're listening. And I didn't show up to a single class the second half of the semester and still pulled out an A, so take that as you want
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Best econ prof I have had. Offers 5% extra credit onto total grade by going to class and doing the bonus quizzes. Tests are very similar to the practice test and homework problems. Her lectures are a little boring because of her accent but she is very good at teaching the content!

Good lecturer, a bit of an accent, but you can totally understand her. Go to every class and she'll teach all of the material at a good pace. The exams look exactly like the homeworks, really easy when you understand the basic concepts. Homeworks can be tricky (get Chegg to double check answers) but the answers are out there.

I ended up with a 98% in this class. If you want a guaranteed good grade and are willing to work, use Doug from Old Army Tutoring. I never went to class and would study what he taught me and got an A on every exam and homework assignment.

She is an awesome economics professor. Many of these negative ratings are just inaccurate descriptions of the class. If you attend class, pay attention in lecture, and do the homework, you will do well in the class. She made the material very easy to understand and she was very organized. Highly recommend taking her class.

Yes, she does have an accent but if you try to pay attention then its not really a big of a problem. She helped me before the exams over zoom when I needed and also after classes. Also, you will get an A on exams if you do the homework's and practice exams. I wish I could take her again for any other courses.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Class was clear and if you are confident in your math then it's easy. Class is pretty straight forward. You get pretty much 5 extra points for your average grade. Just study the slides and hw and tbh not too much need to go to class. Does have a bit of an accent but very understandable. But yea, tests for the most part were pretty easy

Lots of Material, but very good Professor, explains problems well. Easily my favorite Professor this semester as far as teaching style. It takes some work, but Professor Guo gives you the blueprint to be successful in this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: the most confusing professor I have ever had .She expects you to just know things and when asked questions gives a minimal response when it comes to notes and in her lectures she over explains things to a point where she is including unnecessary math. the only reason i am going to pass is doug from old army tutoring. i would avoid her at all cost

Its hard to explain professor Guo, she seems nice until you go to ask question and then she catches an attitude. She has an accent making her hard to understand. She kinda expects you to know things that weren't ever taught in pre-req courses.. Overall I would avoid taking her or go to Old Army tutoring (even then I couldn't pass the exam)

Take this professor! If you put in the work and actually learn the homeworks that she gives you then the tests are easy. She also gives out bonus quizzes in class and you are able to work with your classmates on them. She does have a thick accent but she is always willing to say things again if you do not understand.

Gives extra credit quizzes during class to ensure students come, quizzes are somewhat difficult but not impossible. Because she gives the extra credit she does not bump at all. I ended with a 79.35 and she told me sorry for the disappointment that it was going to stay a C. Very by the book and hard to understand, would not recommend.

She is a really good prof overall. After homework and exams, she devotes an entire class to going over any questions people have. She also offers easy extra credit points throughout the entire semester. Sometimes she can seem to breeze over difficult topics, but is very helpful when you ask for help. I would definitely recommend her!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Extremely fair professor. Anyone who complains about her class probably didn't try enough/study for this course. She does seem to explain easy concepts in a difficult way, but once you understand it it's pretty easy. Has extra credit, exams are very very similar to the homework. Not much studying needed, I'm currently sitting at an A. 6 HW, 3 exams
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I highly recommend avoiding this professor. It is extremely frustrating when she talks fast (made worse by her accent), and doesn't explain concepts in detail or in ways that will help you understand. Going to every lecture, though required, yields very little benefit toward learning material for HW and tests. Incredibly ineffective educator.

Avoid this class at all costs. She does not actually explain how you are supposed to work through problems and just assumes that you already know all the material. This class has some difficult concepts and she does not go in depth on them at all.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Guo is a good professor. Although the material may get a little boring at times, she does a good job of explaining most topics. She gives participation questions that help your grade a lot. The homework is manageable as long as you study. Tests aren't too bad and are based on the homework. An overall manageable class.

If you study the homework for tests, you will do well. The lectures were pretty useless, only because there is a book of the lectures you can buy at the book store. It was a tricky class because the material is a little hard, but I don't think it would necessarily be easier w a diff professor. Bonus points given for attendance/clicker questions.

Avoid at all costs. The lectures are completely useless 1.) because she doesn't explain the problems and gets pissed if you as questions 2.) its really hard to understand her accent. I did above average in the class, but I pulled several all nighters and taught myself everything even though i never missed a class

Its hard to understand her because of the accent. She doesn't explain any problem, she assumes that you know what to do with no explanation. If you want to pass this class you have to get outside help because Professor Guo is worthless at helping.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Bonus points for going to class. Study the homework for the tests. Lectures can be useful sometimes for example problems, but I mostly had to teach myself the material. You can easily get an A if you study the homework.
